title: vercel-labs/agent-browser: a browser an agent drives one command at a time
friendlyTitle: vercel-labs/agent-browser: a browser an agent drives one command at a time
summary: agent-browser was the next unpublished AI repository on GitHub's daily trending page, with 181 stars in that window and 45,790 in total. It is an Apache-2.0 Rust command-line tool from Vercel Labs. A snapshot returns the page as compact text, with a ref such as @e1 for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands. The README says a click fails, instead of reporting success, when the target is hidden, disabled, off-screen, or covered. Refs expire when the page changes, so the next action needs a new snapshot.
friendlySummary: agent-browser was the next unpublished AI repository on GitHub's daily trending page, with 181 stars in that window and 45,790 in total. It is a Rust command-line tool from Vercel Labs, under the Apache-2.0 license. A snapshot returns the page as short text, with a label such as @e1 for each element. The agent acts on that label, reads the page again, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands. The README says a click fails, instead of pretending it worked, when the target is hidden, disabled, off-screen, or covered by something else. Those labels expire when the page changes, so the next action needs a new snapshot.
whyItMatters: Use it when an agent needs to operate a site by reading a text snapshot, not by guessing pixel coordinates. The useful habit is the one in the README: snapshot, act, snapshot again. A ref from the previous page is not a ref on this page. It is a browser tool for an agent you already run, not a model.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it when an agent needs to operate a site by reading a text snapshot, not by guessing where to click on a picture. The useful habit is the one in the README: take a snapshot, act, then take another snapshot. A label from the previous page is not a label on this page. It is a browser tool for an agent you already run, not a model.
